note: EXTENDED 2026-09-09 (dc), FROM DRIVING EVERY REMEDY ON `docs/known-defects.md` RATHER THAN FROM REASONING ABOUT THIS ROW. **THIS ROW VERIFIES THAT A DEFECT IS STATED AND NEVER THAT ITS REMEDY WORKS ([[W125]], `0277`), AND THE DRIVE PRODUCED THE ARGUMENT FOR WHY THAT LIMIT PERSISTS: A REMEDY IS MATERIALLY HARDER TO DRIVE THAN TO WRITE, AND THE FAILURE MODE IS A CLEAN-LOOKING PASS.** Two of the drives behind that pass reached a verdict without touching their subject at all.
